queries.sql: select "sequence", "attempt_id", "direction", "envelope", "received_at" from "usine_attempt_transcripts" where "usine_attempt_transcripts"."attempt_id" = ? order by "usine_attempt_transcripts"."sequence" desc limit ?

select "sequence", "attempt_id", "direction", "envelope", "received_at" from "usine_attempt_transcripts" where "usine_attempt_transcripts"."sequence" in (select max("sequence") from "usine_attempt_transcripts" where (("usine_attempt_transcripts"."attempt_id" = ?) and ((
            json_extract("usine_attempt_transcripts"."envelope", '$.payload._tag') IN ('InterventionApplied', 'InterventionRejected')
            OR (json_extract("usine_attempt_transcripts"."envelope", '$.payload._tag') = 'SessionEvent'
              AND json_extract("usine_attempt_transcripts"."envelope", '$.payload.event._tag') IN ('SessionStarted', 'SessionIdle', 'SessionResumed', 'SessionFinished'))
          ))) group by coalesce(json_extract("usine_attempt_transcripts"."envelope", '$.payload.event.session.id'), json_extract("usine_attempt_transcripts"."envelope", '$.payload.intervention.target.sessionId'), '@parent'), json_extract("usine_attempt_transcripts"."envelope", '$.payload._tag') = 'SessionEvent', json_extract("usine_attempt_transcripts"."envelope", '$.payload.inputSequence'), json_extract("usine_attempt_transcripts"."envelope", '$.payload.event._tag') = 'SessionStarted') order by "usine_attempt_transcripts"."sequence" asc
